kit: 24frames-magazine-layout — 24帧杂志排版（24FRAMES PROJECT 公众号文章排版套件）

safety.draft_add_requires: --yes-add flag AND explicit user approval in chat for that one draft/add
safety.draft_update_only_on: the media_id recorded in the article's state.json (never other drafts)
safety.secrets_note: Never print, copy, commit or log credentials or the token.
safety.secrets: env WECHAT_APPID + WECHAT_APPSECRET, or WECHAT_ENV_FILE=<path to a KEY=VALUE file with both>

fonts.cjk_note: Override with env OA_CJK_BOLD / OA_CJK_REGULAR (any Noto Sans CJK SC / Source Han Sans SC file). Also auto-detected: NotoSansSC* / NotoSansCJK* / SourceHanSansSC* in fonts/, ~/.cache/24frames-magazine-layout/fonts/, ~/Library/Fonts, /Library/Fonts and the usual Linux font dirs.

cover.group: logo + label centred horizontally and vertically on the 1800×766 canvas

verify.wechat_ua: Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 17_0 like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 (KHTML, like Gecko) Mobile/15E148 MicroMessenger/8.0.50(0x18003237) NetType/WIFI Language/zh_CN
verify.wechat_qrcode: pip install --target /tmp/cvc opencv-contrib-python-headless; run with PYTHONPATH=/tmp/cvc
verify.chrome_note: Override with env CHROME_PATH; if neither exists, Playwright's bundled Chromium is used.
